description: Generation stack the contributor used for the MFZ candidates. Measured read-only on the contributor's Windows machine on 2026-10-20. Weights are NOT part of this repository.

image_generator.driver: starsector-sprite-gen skill (sprite_tool.py) submitting the API workflows in assets/mfz/rha/workflows/; the tool script itself is not imported
image_generator.sampler: euler via SamplerCustomAdvanced + BasicGuider (no CFG node)
image_generator.trigger_phrase: Starsector ship sprite on black background.

models.acquisition: UNKNOWN: download source/version not recorded; Flux.2 Klein 9B GGUF Q6_K quantisation
UNKNOWN: the free Starsector-x4 LoRA; exact download URL not recorded

known_reproducibility_gaps: Manifests record lora_strength as null for the Rha rounds; the workflow default 1.0 was presumably used.
ra_a manifest records steps as null; the text-to-image workflow default is 4.
Round 2 denoise (0.52) and steps (16) are recorded in the contributor's notes, not in the manifest file.

Before the idris_big cool_* runs, the contributor's image-guided mode ignored seed and LoRA strength (fixed 2026-10-20); earlier Idris image-guided runs effectively used seed 0 and strength 1.0. The Rha rounds were generated after that fix.
Generation scripts for Idris/Polaris/Perseus raw rounds mostly cannot be replayed: raw generations were deleted from the staging folder.
